# heytownhall_api_keys (Data Source)

The organisation's API keys. Secrets are never part of the answer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "heytownhall_api_keys" "active" {}

output "key_names" {
  value = [for k in data.heytownhall_api_keys.active.keys : "${k.name} (${k.kind})"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_revoked` (Boolean) Also list revoked keys. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) The keys, oldest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the key was created (RFC 3339).
- `display` (String) The key's prefix and last four characters.
- `id` (String) The key's id.
- `kind` (String) `sandbox` or `live`.
- `last_used_at` (String) When the key was last used (RFC 3339), or null.
- `name` (String) The key's name.
- `revoked_at` (String) When the key was revoked (RFC 3339), or null.
